name: walkorbit_quilted_navy
prompt: Five one-second shots joined by hard cuts. The woman walks on the spot the whole time, always facing the same way; only the camera moves, round to her left, always high above looking down on her head, always at the same distance: shot 1 from the front, 2 front-left, 3 her left side, 4 back-left, 5 behind. Quick, short, even steps, three every second, never a run. Flat chroma-key green background.
